patterns.note: A full-width, dense grid of project cards dominates the content area, following an initial asymmetrical hero section.
Project titles consistently feature highly expressive, often custom or bespoke display typography, contrasting with a clean, minimal sans-serif for navigation and body text.
The site uses a stark black and white base palette for its structural elements, allowing the vibrant and diverse colors within project imagery to serve as the primary accents.
The hero section features a large background image/video that remains fixed or subtly parallaxes as the main content scrolls up and over it, creating a layered reveal effect.
The homepage structure moves directly from an impactful hero into a comprehensive, scrollable grid of portfolio projects without intermediate marketing sections.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a full-bleed background video or image that is fixed in the viewport or uses a subtle parallax effect. As the user scrolls, the subsequent content sections scroll up and over this hero element, obscuring it progressively.
The primary navigation bar maintains a sticky position at the top of the viewport, ensuring it is always visible and accessible.
Project cards are arranged in a responsive, dense grid layout, where each card's visual identity is heavily influenced by its unique, often custom-designed typographic title.

design_tokens.type_scale: Highly varied display typography for project titles (often custom and very large) contrasted with a clean, smaller sans-serif for navigation and body text.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and open in the hero section, transitioning to a dense, tightly packed grid for project showcases.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its bold and highly customized typographic treatments within each project card, elevating the portfolio grid from a simple display to an artful showcase. The seamless transition from a fixed/parallaxing hero video to the scrolling project grid creates an immersive and dynamic introduction.
